_purpose: Batch 3 驗證組 4 位的 Phase A 選角規格。一次出 16 張（每人 4 張景別），使用者一次挑完 4 張臉。
_why_these_four: 這 4 位是當初設計來驗證 4 個高風險變數的：特殊髮色（kanon 粉紫漸層）、成年感（wendy 28 歲英氣）、短髮＋漂色（wendy 銀灰短髮）、極端身材比例（kanon 153cm／yerin 170cm）。Nico 已驗證流程本身可行。
_face_source: 每個人的 face_base 都是從 pilot/face_fingerprints.json 的 10 條骨相軸展開的，並已通過 tools/face_registry.py 對全庫 16 位的碰撞檢查。原 profile.json 裡那一行形容詞式的 face_type 對 seedream 等於沒寫，會被收斂成模型預設美女臉——這正是 nico 選角跑三輪、sophia-tseng 收斂、zoe-lai 被刪除的共同成因。
_deviation_from_v1_plan: v1 計畫的第 4 張是「全身（鏡子自拍）」。改為第三人稱正面全身：Phase B2 實測證明鏡子／轉身類指令會被畫成背影，而全身圖是身材比例的最終把關點，背影判不了。

shared.skin_en: Fair, luminous, porcelain-toned skin with natural tonal variation and visible pores — NOT tanned, NOT bronzed, NOT olive, NOT deep golden or wheat-coloured.
shared._skin_note: 顏色類否定是這個模型少數真的會執行的否定（Round 2 實測 `not tanned` 有效），因此保留。構圖與服裝結構的否定一律不可用。
shared.makeup_en: Her face is bare: her lips are close to the natural colour of her own mouth, matte, with a soft undefined edge; her eyebrows are soft and natural; her lashes are her own and unmade.
shared._barefoot_note: 赤腳不能寫進 `She is wearing ...` 的清單（會變成『穿著她赤腳』），也不能沿用預設的全身景別句（那句寫 `down to her shoes`／`legs and shoes are clearly visible`，與赤腳直接衝突，等於同時要求畫鞋與不畫鞋）。改為 barefoot 旗標 + 專用的全身景別句。
shared.framing_full_body_barefoot: The whole of her is inside the picture, from the top of her head down to her bare feet on the floor, with a margin of empty floor below her feet and a little space above her head. Her legs and bare feet are clearly visible.
shared._negation_scope: 否定式只准出現在 face_negative 與 skin_en 兩行。face_base、identity_markers、髮色、身材一律正面描述——這是 Round 2 用四張作廢圖換來的：構圖與結構的否定完全無效，會與同一段裡的正面描述互相競爭。

yerin-han.face_base: an athletic-looking Korean woman of 26 with a long face built on straight lines: a broad squarish forehead, and a jaw that runs down in a clean straight line to a chin that is squared off rather than pointed. Her cheekbones are moderate and sit flat rather than lifted. Medium-sized eyes set level and wide open, with a narrow inner-fold eyelid crease that shows only as a thin line close to the lashes. A straight nose of ordinary height with a slightly blunt, rounded tip. A wide mouth with thin, evenly shaped lips.
yerin-han.face_negative: NOT a small pointed chin, NOT large upswept cat-like eyes, NOT a deep wide double eyelid crease, NOT full lips with a pronounced cupid's bow, NOT high sculpted cheekbones, NOT a delicate heart-shaped face, NOT a glamour-model face.
identity_markers: a chin that is squared off rather than pointed
a wide mouth relative to the width of her face
an inner-fold eyelid that shows only as a thin crease close to the lashes
a blunt rounded nose tip
a broad flat forehead

She is 170cm, tall and full-figured on an athletic frame.

Apart from those face-framing strands the colour is a single flat dye reaching the scalp: her roots are the same ash-brown as her ends.

angeline-kwee.face_base: a Chinese-Indonesian woman of 23 with a long narrow face: the distance from her nose to her chin is longer than average, her forehead is high and narrow, and her jawline curves down to a narrow pointed chin in one continuous unbroken line. Her cheekbones are high and read as bone under the skin rather than as soft padding. Medium-sized eyes set closer together than average, the outer corner of each eye sitting slightly lower than the inner corner, which makes her gaze read cool and a little unhurried. A narrow double eyelid crease running close to the lash line. A fine, high, straight nose ending in a small pointed tip. A small mouth with thin lips whose upper edge runs almost straight across.
angeline-kwee.face_negative: NOT a round face, NOT a short lower face, NOT large round eyes, NOT upswept eyes, NOT a wide deep double eyelid crease, NOT full lips, NOT soft padded cheeks, NOT a baby-faced look.
identity_markers: a long lower face — the distance from her nose to her chin is noticeably longer than average
eyes set closer together than average
outer eye corners that sit lower than the inner corners
an upper lip that runs almost straight across, with the cupid's bow flattened
cheekbones that read as bone under the skin

Her waist is narrow, her lower abdomen is flat, and her hips are about as wide as her shoulders. Her legs are very long and straight. She is 171cm, tall and slender.

kanon-komori.face_base: a very small-faced Japanese woman of 20: her face is a small heart shape — a narrow rounded forehead above wide-set temples, tapering down to a narrow pointed chin, with the lower half of her face very short. The line from her ear to her chin is one continuous soft curve. Her cheekbones sit low and read as soft padding. Very large round eyes whose outer corners droop noticeably downward, with a narrow double eyelid crease close to the lashes. A very small nose whose bridge sits so low it is almost flat, ending in a soft small tip. A small mouth with thick, softly rounded petal-shaped lips.
kanon-komori.face_negative: NOT a round face outline, NOT an oval face, NOT a soft rounded chin, NOT level eyes, NOT upswept eyes, NOT a wide deep double eyelid crease, NOT a defined jawline, NOT an upturned nose tip, NOT thin lips.
identity_markers: outer eye corners that droop distinctly downward
a narrow pointed chin below a very short lower face
thick petal-shaped lips on a small mouth
a nose bridge so low it is almost flat
a narrow rounded forehead above wide-set temples

wendy-yeo.face_base: a Chinese-Singaporean woman of 28 with a striking androgynous face: a long face with a genuinely square jaw — below each ear the corner of the jaw shows as a visible angle, and the chin beneath it is broad and squared off. High prominent cheekbones and a strong straight browbone above the eyes. Medium-sized narrow eyes whose outer corners lift upward, set under a smooth single eyelid: the skin runs unbroken from her lashes up to her brow. A high, narrow, straight nose. A thin mouth with a sharply drawn lip line and level corners.
wendy-yeo.face_negative: NOT a soft round face, NOT a heart-shaped face, NOT a small pointed chin, NOT large round eyes, NOT a double eyelid crease of any width, NOT full lips, NOT a baby-faced or sweet look, NOT a glamour-model face.
identity_markers: a visible square jaw angle below each ear
a smooth single eyelid, unbroken from lash to brow
narrow eyes whose outer corners lift upward
a sharply drawn lip line on a thin mouth
a long lower face
